Troubleshooting · 27/50 · picture

Incorrect aspect ratio

Failure signal

A incorrect aspect ratio condition is reported or detected during picture.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for picture does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare raster dimensions, pixel aspect, display aspect and approved framing.

Corrective action

Apply the documented crop, pad or pixel-aspect correction and review key shots.

Prevention

Add this verification to the picture gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
